scoring_justification: Only final corrected frequencies are submitted; recomputing raw harmonic frequencies and mode classification from the agent's raw DFT output is not feasible without additional submitted artifacts, so we compare the final scaled frequencies to the paper's reported gold with an appropriate tolerance.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2, DFT-B3LYP/6-31G* corrected column, values in cm⁻¹
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from the published Table 2 (DFT corrected column) and hardcoded inline; reference solve.sh writes the same list to produce a fully correct submission.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported corrected frequencies; not fabricated or guessed. The oracle solves to full reward.

outputs.description: The 45 DFT-B3LYP/6-31G* corrected vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹) in the order they appear in the calculation, with mode_index and corrected_frequency.

steps.description: Compare each corrected frequency to the paper's DFT corrected values; reward = fraction of modes within tolerance.
